correctness.rationale: Exact even/odd Gram matrices yield explicit traces/determinants, reducing the E-optimal lower frame bound to the minimum of two 2×2 eigenvalues. A sharp upper bound by the odd lower eigenvalue has unique global maximum: its stationary polynomial factors into a cubic times a sextic; exact rational Sturm sequences and branch isolation show only the smaller sextic root belongs to the lower branch. At the same root both parity lower eigenvalues coincide, attaining the bound. Checker exact root counts and identities replayed from packaged source.

value.rationale: Cubic polynomials form the smallest square two-node first-jet Hermite system. Exact global worst-case stability optimization is nontrivial and distinct from determinant maximization. The unique algebraic spacing and double parity equality space provide a reproducible sharp benchmark in finite Fock sampling. The determinant optimizer has worst-case gain exp(-1), about 24% below the sharp gain (equivalently the sharp gain is about 32% higher).
